metaTitle: ICT40120 Cert IV in IT RPL — Fast Track & Online
metaDescription: Working in IT support or development? Get the ICT40120 Certificate IV in Information Technology through RPL. 100% online. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The ICT40120 Certificate IV in Information Technology is the core IT qualification for support, junior development and systems roles. If you already work in IT, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from your job.
whoIsItFor:
• IT support and help desk technicians
  • Junior developers and web developers
  • Junior systems and network administrators
  • Digital media and web content specialists
  • Self-taught IT workers without a formal qualification

Candidates usually have a year or more in an IT role: resolving client ICT problems, basic programming or scripting, supporting systems and following cyber security, privacy and IP policies.
evidenceExamples:
• Help desk tickets and incident records you've resolved (with client details removed)
  • Code, scripts or websites you've written, such as a GitHub link
  • System documentation, how-to guides or knowledge base articles
  • Vendor certifications, such as CompTIA, Microsoft or Cisco
  • A reference from your manager describing your IT role
description:
The ICT40120 Certificate IV in Information Technology covers broad IT skills: identifying and resolving client ICT problems, applying introductory programming techniques, contributing to cyber security risk management, evaluating emerging technologies, complying with IP, ethics and privacy policies, critical thinking and working collaboratively.

Specialisations include systems administration, networking, programming, web development, cyber security and digital media. It replaces ICT40118 and ICT40815 Certificate IV in Digital Media Technologies.
jobOpportunity: Help desk or service desk analyst
searchAliases: certificate iv in information technology rpl
certificate iv in digital media technologies

faqs.q: Can I get the Certificate IV in IT through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you work in an IT role. Your tickets, code, documentation and a manager's reference are assessed against the units, with electives chosen to match your work.

faqs.q: What replaced the Certificate IV in Digital Media Technologies?
faqs.a: ICT40815 was replaced by ICT40120 Certificate IV in Information Technology. Digital media and web work is now covered through specialisations and electives.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: ICT50220 Diploma of IT RPL — Fast Track & Online
metaDescription: Experienced IT professional? Get the ICT50220 Diploma of Information Technology through RPL. 100% online, Australia-wide. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The ICT50220 Diploma of Information Technology is the qualification for experienced IT professionals and team leads. If you already work as a developer, network or systems administrator, cyber security analyst or IT lead, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from your work.
whoIsItFor:
• Software and web developers
  • Network and systems administrators
  • Cyber security analysts
  • IT team leaders and senior support engineers
  • Digital media and web professionals

Candidates usually have a few years in IT: designing and building solutions, managing client problems, leading or working in a team, promoting cyber security and matching IT to business needs.
evidenceExamples:
• Code repositories, architecture or network diagrams
  • Project documentation, change requests and incident reports
  • Security policies, audits or awareness material you've produced
  • Vendor certifications, such as AWS, Azure, Cisco or CompTIA
  • A reference from your manager describing your role
description:
The ICT50220 Diploma of Information Technology covers IT at a professional level: originating and developing concepts, promoting cyber security awareness, leading a team, matching ICT needs to the organisation's strategy, applying IP, ethics and privacy, and managing client problems.

Specialisations include advanced networking, cyber security, back-end and front-end web development, cloud engineering, systems administration, game art and design, and business analysis. It replaces ICT50120, ICT50118 and ICT50915 Diploma of Digital Media Technologies.

faqs.q: Can I get the Diploma of IT through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you have a few years in IT. Your code, diagrams, documentation and a manager's reference are assessed against the units, with a specialisation that matches your work.
The RTO matches the specialisation to your experience, such as cyber security, networking, web development or systems administration.

faqs.q: What replaced the Diploma of Digital Media Technologies?
faqs.a: ICT50915 was replaced by the Diploma of Information Technology. Digital media and web work is now covered through specialisations.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: ICT60220 Advanced Diploma of IT RPL — Online
metaDescription: Senior IT specialist or manager? Get the ICT60220 Advanced Diploma of Information Technology through RPL. 100% online. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The ICT60220 Advanced Diploma of Information Technology is the senior qualification for IT specialists and managers. If you already lead IT teams, work with clients at a business level or plan business analysis, RPL lets you get it online using evidence from your role.
whoIsItFor:
• IT managers and senior team leads
  • Senior network, security and systems engineers
  • Solutions architects and business analysts
  • Senior developers and technical leads

Candidates usually have several years in senior IT roles, including managing team effectiveness, client engagement at business level, cyber security leadership and business analysis.
evidenceExamples:
• Strategies, roadmaps or architecture documents you've produced
  • Business analysis plans and requirements documents
  • Team management and performance records
  • Security frameworks and risk assessments
  • Senior vendor certifications
  • A reference from your CIO, director or manager
description:
The ICT60220 Advanced Diploma of Information Technology covers senior IT work: critical thinking for complex problems, managing team effectiveness, promoting cyber security, interacting with clients at a business level, managing IP, ethics and privacy, and planning and monitoring business analysis.

Specialisations include cyber security, telecommunications network engineering, IT strategy and organisational development, and cloud architecture. It replaces ICT60120 and ICT60115.

faqs.q: Can I get the Advanced Diploma of IT through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you work in a senior IT role. Your strategies, architecture or analysis documents and a senior reference are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Should I choose the Diploma or the Advanced Diploma?
faqs.a: The Diploma suits experienced technical staff and team leads. The Advanced Diploma suits senior specialists and managers who work at a strategic or business level.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.
